notes.title: Dark Mine Is Now Live — The Depths Are Waiting
notes.content:
The dark tunnels await you!
Cyber752 Games and Indie.io proudly present a dark tunnels nightmare, Dark Mine.

[previewyoutube=uayWotB-4Q4;full][/previewyoutube]

🔦 Key Features

 📷 Night Vision Survival: No flashlight. No weapons. Just you, a drained camera, and the distant sound of something moving. Use your lens to reveal paths, and keep the shadows at bay.
 🐾 Monster That Hunts in Silence: You are not alone. The thing down here sees what you illuminate, and learns. Avoid detection, stay quiet, and don’t look back.
 ⛏️ Retro PSX-Style Visuals: Winding tunnels, crumbling debris, and nowhere to run. Every corner hides danger. Hide before your doom finds you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602880/Dark_Mine/

notes.title: Dark Mine - Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Calling all gold miners!

We are thrilled to announce that Dark Mine is launching on June 24th, 2025!

[previewyoutube=1SFwXCeV_JI;full][/previewyoutube]

The mine took your crew. Don’t let it take you.

Trapped underground after a collapse, you are the sole survivor of a deadly attack. Armed only with a night vision camera, navigate the darkness, avoid the creature, and find a way out in this retro-style survival horror game.


Retro-Style Survival Horror: Dark Mine offers a nostalgic survival horror experience with retro-style visuals, immersing players in a tense and atmospheric underground setting.
Night Vision Camera Gameplay: Players rely on a night vision camera to navigate the pitch-black environment, adding a unique and suspenseful mechanic to the gameplay.
Stealth and Evasion Mechanics: Avoiding the lurking creature requires careful movement and strategic use of the environment, emphasizing stealth over combat.
Claustrophobic Underground Setting: Set in the confines of a collapsed mine, the game intensifies the feeling of isolation and danger as players seek an escape route.


Inspired by the lo-fi tension of classic horror, Dark Mine blends PSX-style visuals with a claustrophobic setting and relentless atmosphere. The mine may be abandoned, but it is far from empty. Every flicker of movement and every distant sound may be the last thing you hear.
